notes.title: Update Pocket Race: Driver v1.1.4
notes.content:
- Fixed a possible problem with gamepad / joystick
- Fixed a problem with hidden cursor in puase (so settings could not be opened from there)

notes.title: Pocket Race: Driver v1.1.3 Update
notes.content: Fixed a problem with joystick / gamepad: when it is detected and already used for menu control, it is also default on for using gamepad/joystick for driving in new game

notes.title: Pocket Race Driver 1.1.2 Update
notes.content: - Minor improvements for gamepad / joystick and HDR output

notes.title: Pocket Race Driver v1.1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a ui problem with player name sometimes disabled
- Made driving a bit little harder but balance a bit more important
- Gave AI drivers a little bit more money so they can upgrade their cars earlier

notes.title: Pocket Race Driver v1.1.0
notes.content:
- added random dynamite on each track
- batterie items got some more power when collecting them
- now there are 3 difficulties to choose from instead of just 2, and it really gets difficult with the highest
- ai cars can get sponsor money now too and so buy more stuff themselves like new chassis and motors

Have fun! Tell us if you want something else too :-)

notes.title: Update v1.0.8
notes.content: Fixed a problem with steam achievements and improved shadow quality a bit.
